data.title: C.C. · 披萨盒旁的赤足托腮
data.action: 趴在起居室长毛地毯上，手里拿着芝士拉丝的披萨，怀里抱着芝士君玩偶，琥珀色眼眸带着戏谑与洞悉一切的淡然注视着鲁路修
data.location: 阿什弗德学园俱乐部起居室厚地毯上
data.lighting: 电视机暖光与单盏地灯的温馨黄光，在纯白拘束服风睡袍与碧绿长发上洒下柔光
data.mood: 慵懒超脱、神秘戏谑、充满烟火气的生活质感
data.description: 阿什弗德学园深夜的学生会起居室。不老不死的魔女C.C.换上一件改良自收容服的纯白极简系带纯棉睡袍，松垮的布料半掩着修长锁骨。她毫无防备地趴在软毛地毯上，双手搂着巨大的黄色芝士君玩偶，嘴里咬着一口热气腾腾的玛格丽特披萨。琥珀色眸子微微挑起，戏谑地瞥向推门的鲁路修——「鲁路修，太慢了。披萨的芝士冷掉可就全怪你了……作为契约的一部分，今晚也乖乖给芝士君买单吧。」
data.promptProse: Sprawled across a plush cream rug in a dim club lounge late at night, C.C. wears a relaxed pure-white cotton wrap nightgown accented with long draping restraint ribbons and loose sleeves. Tucking a Cheese-kun plushie under one arm while eating a slice of melted pizza, she casts a wry, knowing glance beneath warm floor-lamp glow.
data.animaCaption: Sprawled lazily across a thick cream rug in a pure white ribbon-tied wrap nightgown, she hugs a yellow Cheese-kun plushie under one arm while lifting a cheesy slice of pizza with a wry golden glance. Soft floor-lamp warmth and dim screen light wash across the quiet lounge.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pure white relaxed cotton wrap nightgown styled with long trailing restraint ribbons and wide loose sleeves.
